verdict.rationale: Smithery has no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec for its own API. Probes found every candidate OpenAPI and Swagger path returning 404, including the registry's /openapi.json, and the documented API was shut down on 2026-10-31. The per-server generated TypeScript SDKs and server-card JSON describe individual MCP servers, not Smithery's API, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
